question.text: The PMS periodic client/performance report should include:

answer.text: Portfolio composition and value, transactions, expenses, TWRR and benchmark disclosure

explanation.text: The Logic: Periodic client and performance reports cover portfolio composition and value, transactions, expenses, and performance reporting on a Time Weighted Rate of Return (TWRR) basis with appropriate benchmark disclosure. The Trap: Marketing-only or NAV-only disclosures do not satisfy the periodic reporting content required by the source. Note: Restricted-access website delivery is mentioned for reports in the source, but the contents listed above are the substantive requirement.
